title: Hacker News: I'm teaching an introductory 12 week course on Quantum Oracle Engineering
description: HN Score: 29 pts | Comments: 10 | I'm teaching an introductory 12 week course on Quantum Oracle Engineering

ko.title: 양자 오라클 엔지니어링 입문 12주 과정 소개
ko.hook: 양자 컴퓨팅의 핵심인 오라클을 직접 설계하고 구현하는 실전 과정, 지금 바로 확인하세요!
key_takeaways: 다양한 알고리즘에 적용 가능한 오라클 설계 패턴 학습

en.title: Introductory 12-Week Course on Quantum Oracle Engineering
en.hook: Dive into quantum oracle engineering with a hands‑on 12‑week program that teaches you to design and implement the core building blocks of quantum algorithms.
key_takeaways: Understand quantum oracles and their role in quantum algorithms
Hands‑on implementation of oracles using Qiskit or Cirq
Learn reusable oracle design patterns for various quantum algorithms

zh.title: 量子 oracles 工程入门 12 周课程介绍
zh.hook: 深入探索量子计算的核心组件——量子 oracles，参加这个为期12周的实践课程，学习如何设计和实现量子算法的关键构建模块。
key_takeaways: 理解量子 oracles 的概念及其在量子算法中的重要性
使用 Qiskit 或 Cirq 进行 oracles 的实践实现
学习适用于多种量子算法的可复用 oracles 设计模式
